reason: Initial boot/linker bounds, diagnostic reads and half-open clearing ranges confirm accessor data flow; ClearArena has reset/boot-region preservation branches, not unconditional full clearing.

evidence.why: Exact startup condition and allocation.
Descending reservation.

reason: Startup reserves 24 MiB with alignment 4 when simulated size expressed by integer division in MiB equals 48, then measures remaining bounds. This is a configuration description, not proof of the region's later use or an exact byte-equality predicate.

evidence.why: Conditional workspace allocation and handoff.
Low cursor reservation.

reason: Low-end reservation supports early diagnostic workspace; caller skips this setup if debugger is present. No per-block free exists in this API.

evidence.why: Setter and allocator producer.
Boot/linker initial high.
FST loader lifetime and high-bound replacement.

reason: Direct high-bound store connects boot initialization, allocation writeback and FST placement. The loader installs FSTAddress after its drive-status wait; the old high-bound local is not restored.

evidence.why: Boundary API and arithmetic.
Boot initialization, reporting and conditional clearing.
Reservations, fallback branches and saved heap lifetime.

reason: Boot establishes bounds and HSD reserves framebuffer/FIFO or falls back to heap branches; HSD_OSInit advances past allocator metadata, creates audio and general heaps, saves next-arena bounds and installs the general heap end as OS arena low. Alignment/capacity checks belong to callers; getter validation describes source assertions only.
